en: “You scared the shit out of me!”
I got real thirsty in the middle of the night, and right when I open the door to go get a drink, Ayano scares me silly.
She's wearing a bear outfit to bed.
“What are you doing up this late?”
This is the first time I've ever seen Ayano's room, and it's quite different from her strong personality.
There's tons of stuffed animals everywhere, even in the cold air it feels a bit... stuffy.
“I stayed up reading, but I'm getting ready to sleep.”
“Oh... Then just give me the cup when you're finished.”
“Actually, my sisters don't know that I wear this to bed.”
“But since you've seen it, what do you think?”
“That's not what your eyes are saying.”
She does look cute, but her body is just too damn sexy. I mean, look at those curves!
And I'll bet those titties are super soft.
Ayano circles around me and pulls me backward.
Then she squats down and looks up at me with flirtatious eyes.
“I was just reading an erotic novel. Hehe... Kinda in the mood.”
“You shouldn't be reading that before bed!”
She unbuttons a few buttons, and exposes the bottom of her tits.
